sections.title: Class drills: the 8-week starter course
sections.html:
Class drills: the 8-week starter course

One printable page per class for the instructor, matched to the class plans. Every problem was made by the site's own generator and checked against the bead moves taught that week, so no child meets a move they have not learned.

Print the week's page for each child (drill A and B), and keep one copy with the warm-up and flash lists for yourself. Answers are at the end of the file.
